take: Ottawa announced it placed forward Warren Foegele on injured reserve. He had one goal and three assists in 13 games, and the Senators' share of the chances at five-on-five (expected goals, a measure of shot quality) was 48 percent with him on the ice, about two points below their rate without him. In the one game since he went out, Stephen Halliday has taken his spot beside Batherson and Cozens, with Michael Amadio's ice time up to 18:19 a night from 14:20 and Shane Pinto's up to 21:59 from 19:56.
